title: The Relationship Between School Readiness and Sensory Processing Disorder in Preterm Preschooler
brief_summary: The study aims investigate sensory processing disorders and school readiness in pre-school preterm children and the relationship between sensory impairment and school readiness
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* No neurological diagnosis
* gestational age \< 37 weeks
* 60-78 months of age

Exclusion Criteria:

* Have a neurological diagnosis (such as cerebral palsy)
* Grade III or grade IV intraventricular hemorrhage
* Have undergone major surgery in neonatal period
* Mental retardation
